label: Document conversion and bibliography
hints: suniv-doc moves a draft between Markdown, Word, LaTeX and PDF. SUniv does not replace Word or LaTeX: whatever the student writes must come back out in the format their supervisor and their journal expect.

Render citations by passing --bib with the CSL-JSON that suniv-search produced, so every reference in the output traces back to a record that was actually retrieved. Pass --csl when the department imposes a style.
Use --reference-doc to keep a university's Word template when converting to .docx, rather than handing back an unstyled document.
Run `suniv-doc check` before promising an export. When pandoc or latexmk is missing, say so and name what is missing instead of producing a file the student cannot open.
